eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: San Juan, UT; at 1:15 PM on AUG 26, 2025 Effective until 3:15 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Flash Flood Warning for...Southwestern San Juan County in southeastern Utah Northwest Oljeto Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly. Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain. Arroyos streams and rivers can become raging currents in a matter of minutes even from distant rainfall.
